card_sentences: A butcher and a chef in the Bronx make these from turkey raised in upstate New York. They wanted a meat stick that tastes like real food.
allergen_line_verbatim: CONTAINS: MILK, SOY, WHEAT, SESAME, EGG AND MUSTARD (NOT A MAJOR ALLERGEN, LISTED BY THE MAKER) FROM THE SPICE BLEND AND THE CASING GLAZE USED ON EVERY STICK.
may_contain_verbatim: PRODUCED IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO HANDLES PEANUTS, TREE NUTS, FISH AND SHELLFISH.
